newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gilt prices up in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian gilt prices up in light trade.

text.p: * Indian government security prices firm in Tuesday afternoon trade as call money rates are expected to fall but volumes thin, dealers said.
* Sentiment improves as Reserve Bank of India dollar purchases on Monday and Tuesday will inject liquidity into banks over next couple of days and push call rates down, they said.
* Call money eases to 8.5-9.0 percent in afternoon trade from opening quotes of 9.75-10.25.
* In latest deals, 13.70 percent 1999 government of India stock traded at 103.90 rupees against last traded 103.65 and 13.50 percent 1997 at 101.50 against 101.40.
